work-productivity-ontology-typed-workflow-helper 0.1.0

- Initial release focused on practical support for ontology-style workflows with validated user demand from multiple sources.
- Offers step-by-step plans, templates, checklists, automations, and decision aids tailored to work productivity and structured knowledge graph tasks.
- Delivers outputs designed for reliability, easy local implementation, and repeatability.
- Includes built-in validation and usage guidance for actionable results.
